lead_headline: Workflow SDK's replay-correctness sprint leads a dense Wednesday across five active projects
lead_body: Workflow SDK pushed the heaviest commit load of the day, closing stale-wait race conditions, properly guarding event consumers during replay, and surfacing corrupted event logs as distinct errors rather than silent failures. AI SDK shipped speech and transcription gateway support alongside Google service-tier fixes, all backported to v6 within hours. Astro cut two releases anchored by a Vite build-option inheritance regression fix that had been quietly mishandling production client builds.
lead_article:
The busiest thread today belongs to Workflow SDK, which pushed through a dense cluster of replay-correctness work: stale-wait race conditions patched and forward-ported to stable, event consumers properly guarded during replay, and corrupted event logs now surfaced with their own distinct error rather than swallowed quietly. Alongside that correctness run, the trace viewer received colour updates, a reduced-motion accessibility pass, and a bug-fix cleanup — and a new PR landed proposing presigned S3 URLs paired with parallel event-log loading, which would cut cold-load latency on large traces meaningfully. The Nitro v3 `functionRules` refactor also merged this morning, tidying workflow route definitions ahead of whatever comes next in that adapter layer.

AI SDK had a full day of its own: speech and transcription model support shipped to the gateway provider overnight, the Google provider now correctly reads `serviceTier` from both the response header and `usageMetadata` in streaming and generate paths, and the tool-loop agent gained system-role message override support — all three backported to the v6 release branch within hours of merging. Astro shipped two releases, `6.3.6` and `@astrojs/cloudflare@13.5.3`, anchored by a fix that restores proper inheritance of Vite build options — `minify`, `sourcemap`, rollup output — for client environments, a regression that had been quietly mishandling production build configuration. The i18n-on-client fix and the double-encoding check repair rounded out the patch set. Claude Code remained in issue-triage mode: the context-spec regression from 2.1.144 closed, the TUI character-corruption report closed, and a fresh cluster of input-handling and session-resume bugs opened against 2.1.145. Hydrogen tidied its Cart types and moved custom typings to global scope. Metaflow filed a small conftest deduplification against its pytest spin setup.
